reviewItem.question: Does "The Cilium status API now reports the KVStore subsystem with `Disabled` state when disabled, instead of `OK` state and `Disabled` message" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cilium|name=kvstore-subsystem-status-reporting (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: The Cilium status API now reports the KVStore subsystem with Disabled state instead of OK state with Disabled message.
